In recognition of successful completion of the Spanish Language Program and demonstration of proficiency at 
the advanced intermediate level.

Program: Intensive Spanish Language Course
Level Achieved: B2 Upper Intermediate
Course Duration: 180 Hours
The recipient has demonstrated competency in:

Conversational fluency in everyday and professional contexts Comprehension of complex spoken and written Spanish 
Ability to produce clear, detailed text on diverse subjects
Understanding of cultural and regional language variations
